protocol.objective: Fresh paired-seed confirmation of selected Mish+ReLU versus original Mish+GELU
protocol.primary_endpoint: Within each framework, mean across three independent paired training-seed five-task success-rate differences
protocol.statistics: Report each seed, paired-seed t95 df2, hierarchical paired seed/scene bootstrap; do not count scenes/frameworks as independent training seeds
protocol.failures: Preserve every failure; no automatic rerun or dropping failed pairs; no tolerance relaxation
protocol.scheduling: Existing idle RTX4090 port44591, no rental, max4 workers, memory/disk gated; no automatic shutdown; no holding data changes
protocol.scope: small five-task confirmation; three seeds have limited statistical power

limitations: only three fresh training seeds; intervals have substantial uncertainty
five tasks, same 450/100 expert dataset; not full paper benchmark
winner selected before confirmation; original screening scores excluded
framework policies share their seed/case native trained tokenizer
different token vocabularies: absolute policy CE is not a success-rate comparison
no holding-data changes or decoder precision patch applied; original gates preserved
training times measured under contention, not isolated speed rankings
